description: B200 index basket — per-source price capture plus the daily composite, on the same machinery as the B300 lane (shared collectors and calculator code, separate keyspace and methodology). The composite publishes under calc.methodology_id below; USD only (calc.fx_lane none). Every parameter is config, not code; see METHODOLOGY.md.

capture_screens.description: Capture-side data-quality screens, same semantics as the B300 lane: delta report every capture; a constituent whose lowest eligible print moves >= jump_quarantine_pct vs the previous stored snapshot is flagged implausible for that capture unless >= jump_min_corroborators other constituents moved >= jump_corroborate_pct. NOTE: B200 fell ~30% in ~3 weeks May-June 2026 as a REAL market event — the corroboration gate exists precisely so that passes.

calc.description: Daily composite calculation parameters for methodology annex_a2_v0_3_calc_v5. Identical calculation semantics to the B300 lane's annex_a_v0_2_calc_v6 — recorded-currency outlier fence, median-of-votes aggregate, dynamic predictive weighting — as specified in METHODOLOGY.md and docs/dynamic_source_weighting.md, plus this lane's knobs: no FX lane (USD only), claim minimum 5 of 9, and the vast order-book statistic (calc.source_statistics). Every parameter here is embedded verbatim in each published artifact and pinned per methodology_id: any change touching a published day requires minting a new methodology_id (frozen predecessors keep their own keyspaces).

manual_exclusions.reason: capture defect: recorded print known wrong by rule; true print not captured

filter_note: per-source sigma fence over trailing 20 valid observations, computed by the composite under calc above. The window/threshold began as B300 placeholders not yet B200-calibrated (the May-June 2026 -30% episode); recalibrating them requires a new methodology_id.

sources.notes: the on-demand INSTANCE rate, never the 1-Click Cluster committed rate. The Cloud API /instance-types endpoint needs a key; the collector reads the public pricing page.
per-instance pricing (8-GPU) — normalize by the GPU count stated on the provider's own page. LIVE GB200 NVL72 lookalike trap on the same surface (product-identity screen).
GPU Clusters rate ONLY (256-GPU minimum, disclosed) — the Dedicated Inference SKU (~$8.99) for the same silicon is NOT an eligible print.
owner-operator on its own disclosure, held at 10% pending independent verification. Per-node pricing, normalize by stated GPU count.
Community Cloud excluded entirely — the collector must never record communityPrice

8% is a measured liquidity haircut (thin book), revisited quarterly. Calc statistic: volume-weighted median of rentable on-demand asks across verified US/CA hosts (the order-book rule); capture records the deduped book with machine/host identity. Anti-manipulation: no party connected to the index may list on vast so as to influence an observation.
